unnamed_1: All legs on TAR end in a Pit Stop, where teams are told their placement and if they are eliminated or not by Phil. As such, Pit Stops are defined by when teams meet with Phil on a mat, except for Season 1. Normally, the last team to arrive to the Pit Stop are eliminated because the Pit Stop is marked as an elimination point., but occasionally teams will be saved from elimination because the Pit Stop has been designated as a non-elimination point, or teams are told to continue racing. To me, both cases are effectively non-elimination legs. Final Legs are neither elimination or non-elimination legs.
